d:
This horror is scripted. Your goosebumps are not.
A young family goes to see their dying patriarch, only for old familial nightmares to resurface.
"Heirlooms" by Peter Huang
Connect with the Filmmakers:
More About "Heirlooms":
Adam visits his dying father with his wife Jen and young daughter Kylie. His much older sister Ida greets them and reveals that their other sister, Melinda, won’t be returning, even though their father is dying.
The house is lavish, but filled with strange, somewhat frightening heirlooms, as if hinting at a colonial past.
